title: Ram Pothineni's RAPO23 Takes Shape in Pondicherry With Big-Budget Action Sequences
excerpt: The Telugu star's directorial debut, a psychological action thriller with a budget exceeding ₹100 crore, enters an intensive 15-day schedule in Pondicherry featuring choreography by KGF's Vikram Mor.
body:
• Ram Pothineni's directorial debut RAPO23, a psychological action thriller, is filming a critical 15-day schedule in Pondicherry
  • The film carries a reported budget exceeding ₹100 crore — the highest of Ram's career — and is produced by his brother Krishna Pothineni under the Rapo Cinematics banner
  • KGF and Kantara stunt choreographer Vikram Mor is designing the action sequences, while Brinda Master is choreographing a song during this schedule

Ram Pothineni, one of Telugu cinema's most bankable leading men, is deep into production on what may be the most ambitious project of his career — and this time, he is calling the shots from behind the camera as well. RAPO23, his directorial debut, is currently filming an intensive 15-day schedule in Pondicherry, with the team shooting both high-octane action sequences and a visually rich song, according to multiple reports from 123telugu.com and Tupaki.

https://youtube.com/watch?v=jqcboh5ccpI

From Actor to Writer-Director

What sets RAPO23 apart from the standard Telugu big-budget tentpole is Ram's total creative ownership. He wrote the original story, is directing the film, and stars as the protagonist — a character named Veera, introduced through a brooding birthday poster tagged "The Story of a Lone Wolf." The film is described as a psychological action thriller set in a neo-noir world, a genre combination rarely attempted at this scale in Tollywood.

https://x.com/Telugu360/status/2089300173851889975

Produced by Ram's brother Krishna Pothineni under the newly launched Rapo Cinematics banner, the project reportedly carries a budget exceeding ₹100 crore, as reported by Tupaki. It is comfortably the most expensive production Ram has been associated with.

A Heavyweight Technical Crew

The makers have assembled a formidable technical team. National Award-winning cinematographer Thirunavukarasu, known as Thirru, is handling the visuals. The action sequences are being designed by Vikram Mor, whose credits include blockbusters like KGF: Chapter 1, Kantara, and Karuppu. Peter Hein, another veteran stunt choreographer, is also contributing to the film's action design.

"RAPO23 has officially commenced its first shooting schedule in Puducherry after the film's launch and initial music sittings. The schedule will continue until mid August."

— Gulte, reporting from set

The Pondicherry schedule also features a song choreographed by Brinda Master, one of Indian cinema's most sought-after dance directors. Sam CS is composing the film's music, while production designer AS Prakash is building specially designed sets to match the film's scale and vision, according to Cinema Express.

The Stakes for Tollywood

Ram Pothineni, who turned 36 this year, launched RAPO23 with a traditional pooja ceremony on June 29, 2026, followed immediately by the start of regular shooting on the outskirts of Hyderabad. The fact that the film moved to a major location schedule within weeks of its launch suggests the makers are targeting an aggressive timeline.

The female lead is reported to be Samyuktha, though the makers have not officially confirmed her casting, according to Telugu Cinema. No release date has been announced, but the brisk production pace has fueled speculation about a significant theatrical window being targeted.

What to Watch For

For Telugu cinema audiences, RAPO23 represents a rare bet — a mainstream star stepping into the director's chair with a big-budget original, rather than a safe sequel or remake. If Ram can deliver on the neo-noir psychological thriller promise while managing the demands of a ₹100 crore production, the film could mark a turning point in how Tollywood's leading men approach their careers.

Filming is expected to continue through mid-August in Pondicherry before the unit moves to its next schedule.
nri_angle: Ram Pothineni is among the most-followed Telugu stars in the global diaspora, and RAPO23's neo-noir ambitions signal a new creative chapter for Tollywood.
